effectiveDate.note: The Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs independently records exchange of ratification instruments on 7 December 1856.

geometry.derivationNote: The treaty source-verifies that the state boundary passes between Iturup/Etorofu and Urup/Uruppu, with Iturup on the Japanese side and Urup plus the Kurils to the north on the Russian side. The effective chronology is independently fixed by the 7 December 1856 ratification exchange. Exact inter-island maritime line and period coastlines remain pending; this must not be expanded into a modern EEZ-style boundary.

territoryChanges.notes: Legal boundary status is source-verified at ratification exchange; no exact modern maritime geometry is asserted.

geometry.derivationNote: The treaty source-verifies that Sakhalin/Karafuto remained unpartitioned rather than assigning the entire island to either state. This is shared/undivided legal-status metadata on the claim track, not a Russian sovereign-territory mutation: it must not add Sakhalin to the Russian core-territory replay or require a Russian territory-area polygon. Any optional visualization of the shared status belongs to a separate claim layer and must use period coastline, settlement and control geometry independently of core territorial materialization.

territoryChanges.notes: This is an undivided/shared legal-status layer, later superseded by the 1875 Petersburg settlement.
